notes: v0.3.23 - updates apply themselves now. After updating you were still looking at the old interface until you pressed Ctrl+Shift+R: every file the app loads now carries the version in its address, and the page waits for the dashboard itself to come back before reloading instead of reloading when the agent answered. Also: "shut down everything" no longer tells you to reinstall for something no installer has ever been able to do - it now says what is true and points at quitting Docker Desktop from the tray. Stopping it from the button is the next release.
